summary: Frontend-only verification of two new features: (1) light/dark theme toggle in TopBar via next-themes; (2) Mini Simulations panel on Dashboard below SignalFeed. Logged in as xambiep90, verified default dark theme (document.documentElement.className='dark', bg rgb(9,9,11)). Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle-btn) switches <html> class to 'light' (bg rgb(249,249,251)) and back to 'dark'; UI remains readable in light mode (header, stats, strategy cards, panels — see screenshot). Mini Simulations panel renders below Trade Alerts (sfTop=680.5, msTop=1043.5), shows median line + sample paths, all four stat chips (Typical end $63.92, Good case $94.50, Rough case $44.76, Chance of profit 100% for MACD + Volume Confirm), and description mentions $20 and 20 trades. 'Run again' button (data-testid=run-sim-btn) works. Selecting EMA 9/21 Crossover updates the panel (sample_size 17, prob_profit 51.5%). Regression: price-chart, signal-feed, backtest-panel, paper-panel, evolution-panel, settings dialog all render. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: 'Run again' spinner is very brief because queryClient.invalidateQueries resolves fast; consider forcing isFetching UI for a minimum duration so users see feedback. Not a blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (theme toggle + MiniSimulations) verified end-to-end on preview URL. Non-proven crawlers (RSI Mean Reversion) correctly show the 'Test this crawler first' empty state. Dark is default via ThemeProvider in App.js.
